data.rationale: The proposal only covers the first step of the true workflow (searching GitHub and opening a user profile). It leaves out the top pinned repo, the blog lookup, the email draft in the Mail tab, and the Discard, and it is missing the blog and role parameters. It could automate the profile lookup but not the real task.
